plugin.description: DSH ProjectOps — project engineering copilot: structure scan, dependency analysis, SQLite task tracking, architecture docs
tool.scan_project.description: Scan a project directory inside an authorized workspace and return the directory tree, file-type stats, per-directory summary, plus heuristic detection of languages, entry points, config files and package managers. Read-only: never modifies files and never reads .env or other secrets. path must stay inside the authorized workspace. Detection is heuristic, not a definitive conclusion; cached=true means a scan-cache hit.
tool.scan_project.params.path: Project directory to scan; relative paths resolve against the current workspace. Defaults to the workspace root. Must be inside the authorized workspace.
tool.scan_project.params.maxDepth: Maximum tree depth (1-32, defaults to the plugin config)
tool.scan_project.params.maxEntries: Maximum number of entries to walk (1-200000, defaults to the plugin config)
tool.scan_project.params.includeHidden: Include dot-prefixed hidden files/directories (defaults to the plugin config)
tool.scan_project.params.includeTree: Return the rendered tree text (default true)
tool.analyze_dependencies.description: Analyze module imports of a project inside the authorized workspace: module list, dependency edges, suspected cycles (strongly connected components), external imports, unresolved imports and a Mermaid diagram. Supports Python and TypeScript/JavaScript. Read-only and lexically static: dynamic imports cannot be detected.
tool.analyze_dependencies.params.path: Project directory to analyze; relative paths resolve against the current workspace. Defaults to the workspace root.
tool.analyze_dependencies.params.maxFile: Maximum number of source files to analyze (1-20000, defaults to the plugin config)
Maximum bytes read per file (defaults to the plugin config)
tool.analyze_dependencies.params.languag: Which language to analyze: auto (default, by file count) / python / javascript
tool.analyze_dependencies.params.include: Return the Mermaid diagram text (default true)
tool.task_create.description: Create a development task in the workspace task store (SQLite). Writes only to the workspace .projectops/ directory; dependsOn ids must already exist.
tool.task_create.params.title: Task title (required, non-empty)
tool.task_create.params.dependsOn: Prerequisite task ids; this task cannot advance until they complete
tool.task_list.description: List tasks in the workspace task store, optionally filtered by state. Read-only.
tool.task_list.params.state: Only this state: pending / in_progress / completed / failed
tool.task_get.description: Read one task with its dependency states and recent execution records. Read-only.
tool.task_update.description: Update a task's state or fields and append an execution record in the same transaction. Advancing is refused while prerequisites are unfinished; entering in_progress bumps attempts; failure messages are redacted. Writes only the task store.
tool.task_update.params.title: New title
tool.task_update.params.message: One-line note for the execution record (redacted automatically)
tool.task_update.params.errorCode: Error code when failing, e.g. PERMISSION_DENIED
tool.generate_architecture_report.descri: Generate a Markdown architecture document: overview, directory structure, factual module/directory stats, dependency graph with Mermaid, confirmed issues, heuristic observations and suggestions. dryRun defaults to true (preview only) and existing files are never overwritten unless allowed.
tool.generate_architecture_report.params: Project directory (defaults to the workspace root), must be inside the authorized workspace
Output path relative to the project root (default docs/architecture.md)
Include the current task queue in the report (default true)
Turn confirmed findings into tasks (default false, de-duplicated by title)
Preview only, do not write (default true; pass false to write)
Allow overwriting an existing file (default false)
tool.generate_readme_draft.description: Generate a README draft (intro, features, quick start, structure, entry points, license placeholder). Writes README.generated.md by default and never touches an existing README.md; dryRun defaults to true.
tool.generate_readme_draft.params.path: Project directory (defaults to the workspace root)
tool.generate_readme_draft.params.output: Output path relative to the project root (default README.generated.md)
tool.generate_readme_draft.params.projec: Project name for the title (defaults to the directory name)
tool.generate_readme_draft.params.overwr: Allow overwriting an existing file (default false)
tool.plugin_info.description: Return the plugin version, build-artifact time, mount time, runtime info, effective config and registered tool list. Call it first after an upgrade or hot reload to confirm which build is actually live. Read-only.
tool.plugin_logs.description: Return the plugin's recent runtime log records (ring buffer, up to 200, secrets redacted). The plugin does not write to stderr by default; use this for troubleshooting. Read-only.
tool.plugin_logs.params.limit: How many records to return (default 30, max 200)
